name: Dishwater Nell
text: Start of your turn: upgrade your shop's lowest-tier unit to your tier. If it rose 2+ tiers and this touches an Ooze, gain 1 gold.
golden_text: Start of your turn: upgrade your shop's 2 lowest-tier units to your tier. If one rose 2+ tiers and this touches an Ooze, gain 2 gold.
details: It becomes a random unit of your tier. Only your first Nell pays.
